role.description: The role of the message sender. It can be 'system', 'developer', 'user', 'human', 'tool', 'function', 'ai', or 'assistant'.

oneOf.description: Text content, as a simple string.
An array of content parts, which can be multiple 'text' types or one 'refusal' type.

type.description: The type of the content part. It can be either 'text' or 'refusal'.

content.description: The actual content of the part.

refusal.description: The refusal message by the assistant.

id.description: The id of the tool call.

function.description: The function that the model called.

tool_call_id.description: Tool call that this message is responding to.

name.description: The name of the function being called.

arguments.description: Arguments to pass to the function.

function_call.description: Only present when role is 'assistant' and the assistant is invoking a function.

name.description: The name of the message sender.
